##### 1. Official Upstream Source, Immutable Commit Permalinks & Verification Boundary

The local layout, authority derivation, vault contracts, and reserve accounting rules were checked against the authoritative open-source Raydium CPMM repository:

- **Upstream Repository**: [`https://github.com/raydium-io/raydium-cp-swap`](https://github.com/raydium-io/raydium-cp-swap)
- **Immutable Commit Permalink**: [`https://github.com/raydium-io/raydium-cp-swap/commit/b3187ae53a1b95a201f855a59024a12ca8f5b51a`](https://github.com/raydium-io/raydium-cp-swap/commit/b3187ae53a1b95a201f855a59024a12ca8f5b51a) (Pull Request #80: _"Feat/creator fee share"_, author: `RainRaydium`, `0x777A`)
- **Authoritative Source File Permalinks**:
  - `PoolState` Account Struct: [`programs/cp-swap/src/states/pool.rs`](https://github.com/raydium-io/raydium-cp-swap/blob/b3187ae53a1b95a201f855a59024a12ca8f5b51a/programs/cp-swap/src/states/pool.rs)
  - `initialize` Instruction Accounts: [`programs/cp-swap/src/instructions/initialize.rs`](https://github.com/raydium-io/raydium-cp-swap/blob/b3187ae53a1b95a201f855a59024a12ca8f5b51a/programs/cp-swap/src/instructions/initialize.rs)
  - Authority PDA Constant Seed (`AUTH_SEED`): [`programs/cp-swap/src/lib.rs`](https://github.com/raydium-io/raydium-cp-swap/blob/b3187ae53a1b95a201f855a59024a12ca8f5b51a/programs/cp-swap/src/lib.rs)

**Verification Against Upstream Commit `b3187ae53a1b95a201f855a59024a12ca8f5b51a`**:

1. **Binary Layout Alignment**:
   - `PoolState` is declared with `#[account(zero_copy(unsafe))]` and `#[repr(C, packed)]`.
   - First 8 bytes: Anchor account discriminator `sha256("account:PoolState")[0..8] = [0xf7, 0xed, 0xe3, 0xf5, 0xd7, 0xc3, 0xde, 0x46]`.
   - Total binary length: exactly **637 bytes** (`PoolState::LEN` is 637 including the 8-byte Anchor discriminator; the packed struct size is 629 bytes, verified by upstream `pool.rs` unit tests: `pool_state_size_test` asserts `std::mem::size_of::<PoolState>() == PoolState::LEN - 8` (629 bytes), and `pool_state_size_is_unchanged` asserts `PoolState::LEN == 637`).
   - Field offsets match local constants in `RaydiumCpmmParser.ts` byte-for-byte:
     - 10 Pubkeys (32 bytes each, offsets 8..328): `amm_config` (8), `pool_creator` (40), `token_0_vault` (72), `token_1_vault` (104), `lp_mint` (136), `token_0_mint` (168), `token_1_mint` (200), `token_0_program` (232), `token_1_program` (264), `observation_key` (296).
     - Byte flags and decimals (5 bytes, offsets 328..333): `auth_bump` (328), `status` (329), `lp_mint_decimals` (330), `mint_0_decimals` (331), `mint_1_decimals` (332).
     - Little-endian u64 fields (56 bytes, offsets 333..389): `lp_supply` (333), `protocol_fees_token_0` (341), `protocol_fees_token_1` (349), `fund_fees_token_0` (357), `fund_fees_token_1` (365), `open_time` (373), `recent_epoch` (381).
     - Creator fee fields (offsets 389..413): `creator_fee_on` (389, u8), `enable_creator_fee` (390, u8), `padding_1` (391..397, `[u8; 6]`), `creator_fees_token_0` (397..405, u64), `creator_fees_token_1` (405..413, u64).
     - Trailing padding (offsets 413..637): `padding` (224 bytes, `[u64; 28]`).
2. **Program & Authority Derivation (Canonical Bump 253)**:
   - Canonical CPMM Program ID: `CPMMoo8L3F4NbTegBCKVNunggL7H1ZpdTHKxQB5qKP1C`.
   - Global Vault & LP Mint Authority PDA derived with constant seed `b"vault_and_lp_mint_auth_seed"` (`AUTH_SEED` in `lib.rs`).
   - PDA computation: `PublicKey.findProgramAddressSync([Buffer.from("vault_and_lp_mint_auth_seed")], CPMM_PROGRAM_ID)`.
   - Constant Authority Address: `GpMZbSM2GgvTKHJirzeGfMFoaZ8UR2X7F4v8vHTvxFbL`.
   - **Canonical Bump: 253 / `0xfd` (NOT 254)**: Local Solana Web3 derivation (`PublicKey.findProgramAddress` / `findProgramAddressSync`) confirms the canonical bump is **253**. Attempting bump 254 via `PublicKey.createProgramAddressSync` fails with `Error: Invalid seeds, address must fall off the curve` because bump 254 falls on the ed25519 elliptic curve.
   - **Adapter Validation Requirement**: The adapter must explicitly check `pool.auth_bump === 253`. Any pool state presenting `auth_bump !== 253` must be rejected with `AUTH_BUMP_INVALID`.
   - **Synthetic Fixtures Notice**: Existing synthetic test generators (`AuthoritativeCpmmFixtures.ts`) default to `options.authBump ?? 254`. Unit tests for `RaydiumCpmmPoolStateAdapter` must explicitly pass `authBump: 253` when constructing synthetic fixture buffers.
3. **Vault Relationships**:
   - Token vaults (`token_0_vault`, `token_1_vault`) are standard Solana token accounts (165 bytes).
   - In upstream `initialize.rs`, vaults are initialized with owner set to the global Authority PDA (`GpMZbSM2GgvTKHJirzeGfMFoaZ8UR2X7F4v8vHTvxFbL`).
   - Mint fields must match `token_0_mint` and `token_1_mint`.
   - SPL token account state must be `1: Initialized` (byte 108).
4. **Reserve Accounting Engine**:
   - In upstream `pool.rs`, `vault_amount_without_fee(vault_amount, total_fees)` computes:
     `effective_reserve = vault_amount - (protocol_fees + fund_fees + creator_fees)`.
   - Accounting is exact non-negative integer subtraction: if `vault_amount < total_fees`, the pool is insolvent.

> [!WARNING]
> **Source Matching vs. Deployed Program Verification Boundary**:
> The local byte layout, discriminator, offsets, and accounting formulas match the official open-source GitHub source code at commit `b3187ae53a1b95a201f855a59024a12ca8f5b51a`.
> However, **on-chain deployed bytecode verification remains unverified**: there is no independent, cryptographic verified build proof (e.g. Anchor verifiable build hash linking Mainnet bytecode of `CPMMoo8L3F4NbTegBCKVNunggL7H1ZpdTHKxQB5qKP1C` to commit `b3187ae53a1b95a201f855a59024a12ca8f5b51a`) verified in this workspace.
> The proposed adapter enforces strict adherence to the open-source protocol layout, but documents the on-chain deployed bytecode correspondence as an **unverified external dependency**.

##### 2. Analysis of Existing Local Parsers: Reusable Components vs. Corrections Needed

Review of existing pilot components (`RaydiumCpmmParser.ts`, `PoolInitializationParser.ts`, `AuthoritativeCpmmFixtures.ts`) against the single-candidate coordinator requirements reveals what can be reused and what must be narrowed:

1. **Reusable Parsing Assets**:
   - `RaydiumCpmmParser.ts`:
     - Constant offsets (`RAYDIUM_CPMM_OFFSETS`), buffer length (`637`), discriminator (`0xf7ede3f5d7c3de46`), and canonical authority (`GpMZbSM2GgvTKHJirzeGfMFoaZ8UR2X7F4v8vHTvxFbL`).
     - Zero-copy binary decoding of pubkeys, decimals, and little-endian u64 integers.
     - Pure BigInt fee liability subtraction (`vault - (protocol + fund + creator)`).
     - SPL Token vault account parsing (165 bytes, authority verification, account state check).
   - `AuthoritativeCpmmFixtures.ts`:
     - Binary buffer generator for testing 637-byte CPMM pool states and 165-byte vaults.
     - **Strict Labelling Invariant**: Must be explicitly documented in all tests and comments as **synthetic in-memory byte generators**, not on-chain captured evidence.

2. **Assumptions Requiring Correction / Narrowing in the Candidate-Scanner Adapter**:
   - **Account Identity & Anti-Manufacturing Rule**:
     - `RaydiumCpmmParser.ts` accepts `parseRaydiumCpmmAccount(data, poolAddress)` and blindly reflects the supplied `poolAddress` into the returned `state.poolAddress`.
     - In `RaydiumCpmmPoolStateAdapter.ts`, all raw account inputs (`poolAccount`, `vault0Account`, `vault1Account`) must carry an explicit, independently acquired `address: string`.
     - The adapter validates that all addresses are canonical base58 32-byte public keys (rejecting malformed strings with `ADDRESS_MALFORMED`), allowing PDAs without requiring addresses to be on-curve.
     - Verifies `poolAccount.address === target.poolAddress` (rejecting mismatch with `POOL_ADDRESS_MISMATCH`), and verifies `vault0Account.address === token_0_vault` and `vault1Account.address === token_1_vault` (rejecting mismatch with `VAULT_ADDRESS_MISMATCH`). The adapter never manufactures pool identity by passing `target.poolAddress` into the parser and comparing it back.
     - Enforces that `target.candidateMint` must differ from canonical WSOL (rejecting with `CANDIDATE_MINT_IS_WSOL`).
     - Requires exactly one pool mint to be canonical WSOL, and the other to match `target.candidateMint` (`NON_WSOL_PAIR`, `CANDIDATE_MINT_MISMATCH`).
     - Enforces canonical lexicographical byte ordering: `token_0_mint < token_1_mint` (rejecting violations with `CANONICAL_MINT_ORDER_VIOLATED`).
     - Reconciles duplicate mint failures consistently into `IDENTICAL_MINTS` (removing overlapping `CONTRADICTORY_MINTS`).
     - If the pool records identical vault addresses (`token_0_vault === token_1_vault`), it must be rejected with `CONTRADICTORY_VAULTS`.
   - **Protocol Fields & Structural Success Boundary**:
     - `creator_fee_on`: Accepts enum values `0` (BothToken), `1` (OnlyToken0), and `2` (OnlyToken1); values $> 2$ are rejected with `MALFORMED_CREATOR_FEE_FLAG`.
     - `enable_creator_fee`: Accepts encoded boolean byte `0` or `1`; values $> 1$ are rejected with `MALFORMED_CREATOR_FEE_FLAG`.
     - `status`: Decoded as a bitmask (0..7). Returns `poolStatus: number` and `swapEnabledByStatus: boolean` rather than rejecting every nonzero status. Statuses 0–3 allow swaps (`swapEnabledByStatus: true`); statuses 4–7 disable swaps (`swapEnabledByStatus: false`). Statuses $> 7$ (unknown higher bits) are rejected with `INVALID_STATUS`.
     - **Padding**: Does not invent a zero-padding requirement (arbitrary padding bytes in `padding_1` or `padding` are accepted without refusal).
     - **Snapshot Boundary**: Structural success describes only the supplied account snapshot; it is **not strategy admission** or proof that `swapActivationTimeSec` has passed. Freshness and deployed-bytecode correspondence remain unverified external dependencies.
   - **Strict Slot Provenance Policy**:
     - All three accounts (`poolAccount`, `vault0Account`, `vault1Account`) must provide a valid `slot` property.
     - Slots must be present, defined, non-negative safe integers (`typeof slot === "number" && Number.isSafeInteger(slot) && slot >= 0`). Missing, undefined, NaN, non-integer, or negative slots fail closed with `SLOT_PROVENANCE_MISSING_OR_INVALID`.
     - All three account slots must be strictly equal (`poolAccount.slot === vault0Account.slot && vault0Account.slot === vault1Account.slot`). Any discrepancy fails closed with `SLOT_DISCREPANCY` (no permissive flagging).
     - **Limitation**: Matching slots proves only **provider-relative slot consistency** across the accounts fetched; it does not prove real-time freshness against the Solana cluster tip or constitute proof of an atomic read.
   - **Strict Numeric & Metadata Boundaries**:
     - **WSOL Decimals**: The WSOL mint recorded decimals in `PoolState` must equal exactly 9. If `quoteDecimals !== 9`, refuse with `WSOL_DECIMALS_INVALID`.
     - **Candidate / LP Decimals**: Decimals must be $\le 18$. If $> 18$, refuse with `INVALID_DECIMALS`.
     - **Swap Activation Time**: Decoded u64 field `open_time` (offset 373) is preserved exactly as `bigint` named `swapActivationTimeSec: bigint`. This represents the swap unlock/activation timestamp configured by the pool creator, NOT pool creation time or transaction confirmation time.
     - **Reserves & Fees**: Authoritative balance and fee liability quantities are preserved as exact `bigint` types (`baseVaultRaw`, `quoteVaultRaw`, `baseTotalFeesRaw`, `quoteTotalFeesRaw`, `baseEffectiveReserveRaw`, `quoteEffectiveReserveRaw`). Decimal-adjusted quantities and spot prices are approximate floating-point representations and are explicitly labelled with `Approx` (`baseEffectiveReserveApproxDecimal`, `quoteEffectiveReserveApproxDecimal`, `spotPriceSolApprox`).
     - **LP Supply**: Preserved as `lpSupply: bigint` and explicitly documented as unverified pool-reported metadata, NOT verified on-chain mint supply or proof of LP token burning or locking.
   - **Strict Restriction to Canonical SPL Token (De-scoping Token-2022)**:
     - Both candidate and WSOL programs must be canonical SPL Token (`TokenkegQfeZyiNwAJbNbGKPFXCWuBvf9Ss623VQ5DA`).
     - Token-2022 (`TokenzQdBNbLqP5VEhdkAS6EPFLC1PHnBqCXEpPxuEb`) is strictly rejected fail-closed (`UNSUPPORTED_TOKEN_PROGRAM`).
   - **Canonical Authority Bump**:
     - Must fail closed with `AUTH_BUMP_INVALID` if `auth_bump !== 253`.

##### 3. Proposed Module Contract: `RaydiumCpmmPoolStateAdapter.ts`

- **Proposed Target Path**: `backend/src/candidate-scanner/RaydiumCpmmPoolStateAdapter.ts`
- **Pure Entrypoint**:

**TypeScript Contract Specification**:

```typescript
export interface RaydiumCpmmPoolTarget {
  readonly poolAddress: string;
  readonly candidateMint: string;
}

export interface RaydiumCpmmRawAccount {
  readonly address: string;
  readonly data: Uint8Array | Buffer;
  readonly ownerProgramId: string;
  readonly slot: number;
}

export interface RaydiumCpmmPoolStateInput {
  readonly target: RaydiumCpmmPoolTarget;
  readonly poolAccount: RaydiumCpmmRawAccount;
  readonly vault0Account: RaydiumCpmmRawAccount;
  readonly vault1Account: RaydiumCpmmRawAccount;
}

export type RaydiumCpmmPairOrientation =
  | "TOKEN_0_BASE_WSOL_QUOTE" // token_0 is candidate, token_1 is WSOL
  | "TOKEN_1_BASE_WSOL_QUOTE"; // token_1 is candidate, token_0 is WSOL

export interface RaydiumCpmmPoolStateSuccess {
  readonly ok: true;
  readonly poolAddress: string;
  readonly candidateMint: string;
  readonly wsolMint: string; // Canonical WSOL: So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112
  readonly orientation: RaydiumCpmmPairOrientation;
  readonly baseDecimals: number;
  readonly quoteDecimals: number; // Exactly 9
  readonly baseVaultAddress: string;
  readonly quoteVaultAddress: string;
  readonly baseVaultRaw: bigint;
  readonly quoteVaultRaw: bigint;
  readonly baseTotalFeesRaw: bigint;
  readonly quoteTotalFeesRaw: bigint;
  readonly baseEffectiveReserveRaw: bigint;
  readonly quoteEffectiveReserveRaw: bigint;
  readonly baseEffectiveReserveApproxDecimal: number;
  readonly quoteEffectiveReserveApproxDecimal: number;
  readonly spotPriceSolApprox: number; // Approximate SOL per base token
  readonly swapActivationTimeSec: bigint; // Pool-configured swap unlock time (open_time), not creation time
  readonly poolStatus: number; // Decoded status byte (0..7)
  readonly swapEnabledByStatus: boolean; // true if status 0..3, false if 4..7 (bit 2 / mask 4 disables swaps)
  readonly lpMint: string;
  readonly lpSupply: bigint; // Pool-reported metadata, not verified mint supply or LP lock proof
  readonly verification: {
    readonly ownerVerified: true;
    readonly vaultAuthoritiesVerified: true;
    readonly tokenProgramsVerified: true;
    readonly authBumpVerified: true;
    readonly slotProvenance: {
      readonly poolSlot: number;
      readonly vault0Slot: number;
      readonly vault1Slot: number;
      readonly consistentSlot: number;
    };
  };
}

export interface RaydiumCpmmPoolStateFailure {
  readonly ok: false;
  readonly refusalCode: RaydiumCpmmPoolStateRefusalCode;
  readonly message: string;
}

export type RaydiumCpmmPoolStateResult = RaydiumCpmmPoolStateSuccess | RaydiumCpmmPoolStateFailure;
```

**Exhaustive Refusal Taxonomy**:

| Refusal Code                         | Condition / Rejection Rationale                                                                                |
| :----------------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `ADDRESS_MALFORMED`                  | Target, pool, or vault address is not a valid canonical 32-byte base58 public key.                             |
| `POOL_BUFFER_INVALID_LENGTH`         | Pool account buffer length !== 637 bytes.                                                                      |
| `POOL_DISCRIMINATOR_MISMATCH`        | Account bytes 0..8 !== `0xf7ede3f5d7c3de46` (Anchor `PoolState`).                                              |
| `POOL_OWNER_UNAUTHORIZED`            | Pool account owner !== `CPMMoo8L3F4NbTegBCKVNunggL7H1ZpdTHKxQB5qKP1C`.                                         |
| `POOL_ADDRESS_MISMATCH`              | `poolAccount.address` !== `target.poolAddress`.                                                                |
| `CANDIDATE_MINT_IS_WSOL`             | `target.candidateMint` === canonical WSOL (`So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`).                     |
| `CANDIDATE_MINT_MISMATCH`            | Neither token 0 mint nor token 1 mint matches `target.candidateMint`.                                          |
| `NON_WSOL_PAIR`                      | Neither token 0 mint nor token 1 mint is canonical WSOL.                                                       |
| `IDENTICAL_MINTS`                    | Token 0 mint === token 1 mint (duplicate / degenerate pool mints).                                             |
| `CANONICAL_MINT_ORDER_VIOLATED`      | Token 0 mint > token 1 mint in 32-byte lexicographical order (violates CPMM canonical ordering).               |
| `CONTRADICTORY_VAULTS`               | `token_0_vault` === `token_1_vault` (invalid / degenerate vault setup).                                        |
| `AUTH_BUMP_INVALID`                  | Pool decoded `auth_bump !== 253` (canonical bump for seed `vault_and_lp_mint_auth_seed`).                      |
| `INVALID_STATUS`                     | Pool decoded `status > 7` (exceeds known 3-bit status mask 0..7).                                              |
| `MALFORMED_CREATOR_FEE_FLAG`         | Decoded `creator_fee_on > 2` or `enable_creator_fee > 1` (creator_fee_on in 0..2, enable_creator_fee in 0..1). |
| `CORRUPTED_LAYOUT`                   | Struct binary layout corruption, unexpected EOF, or integer decode failure.                                    |
| `UNSUPPORTED_TOKEN_PROGRAM`          | Token 0 or token 1 program !== canonical SPL Token (explicitly rejects Token-2022).                            |
| `INVALID_DECIMALS`                   | Base mint decimals > 18 or LP mint decimals > 18.                                                              |
| `WSOL_DECIMALS_INVALID`              | WSOL-side recorded decimals !== 9.                                                                             |
| `VAULT_BUFFER_INVALID_LENGTH`        | Vault 0 or vault 1 buffer length !== 165 bytes (SPL Token account).                                            |
| `VAULT_ADDRESS_MISMATCH`             | `vault0Account.address !== token_0_vault` or `vault1Account.address !== token_1_vault`.                        |
| `VAULT_OWNER_UNAUTHORIZED`           | Vault owner program !== canonical SPL Token program (`TokenkegQfeZyiNwAJbNbGKPFXCWuBvf9Ss623VQ5DA`).           |
| `VAULT_MINT_MISMATCH`                | Vault decoded mint does not match the corresponding pool token mint.                                           |
| `VAULT_AUTHORITY_UNAUTHORIZED`       | Vault decoded authority !== canonical CPMM authority `GpMZbSM2GgvTKHJirzeGfMFoaZ8UR2X7F4v8vHTvxFbL`.           |
| `VAULT_STATE_NOT_INITIALIZED`        | Vault account state !== 1 (e.g. uninitialized 0 or frozen 2).                                                  |
| `INSOLVENT_RESERVES`                 | Vault raw balance < accrued fee liabilities (`protocol_fees + fund_fees + creator_fees`).                      |
| `ZERO_EFFECTIVE_RESERVES`            | Effective reserve after fee liability deduction === 0n.                                                        |
| `SLOT_PROVENANCE_MISSING_OR_INVALID` | Pool or vault slot is missing, undefined, NaN, non-integer, or negative (< 0).                                 |
| `SLOT_DISCREPANCY`                   | Valid account slots differ (`poolSlot !== vault0Slot` or `vault0Slot !== vault1Slot`). Fail closed.            |

##### 4. Proposed Acceptance Test Suite: `RaydiumCpmmPoolStateAdapter.test.ts`

- **Proposed Target Path**: `backend/src/candidate-scanner/RaydiumCpmmPoolStateAdapter.test.ts`
- **Fixture Policy**: Tests use synthetic in-memory byte generators derived from `AuthoritativeCpmmFixtures.ts`. All test fixtures are clearly documented as **synthetic in-memory byte generators**, not on-chain captured evidence. Tests must explicitly pass `authBump: 253` to override the fixture generator's default bump 254 (`options.authBump ?? 254`).

**Test Coverage Plan (9 Groups)**:

1. **Group 1: Pool Buffer & Discriminator Validation**:
   - Accepts valid 637-byte buffer with discriminator `0xf7ede3f5d7c3de46`.
   - Rejects truncated buffer (< 637 bytes) with `POOL_BUFFER_INVALID_LENGTH`.
   - Rejects oversized buffer (> 637 bytes) with `POOL_BUFFER_INVALID_LENGTH`.
   - Rejects wrong discriminator with `POOL_DISCRIMINATOR_MISMATCH`.
2. **Group 2: Account Ownership, Program & Authority Invariants**:
   - Rejects pool account owned by non-CPMM program with `POOL_OWNER_UNAUTHORIZED`.
   - Accepts pool with `auth_bump === 253`; rejects pool with `auth_bump === 254` or other value with `AUTH_BUMP_INVALID`.
   - Accepts status bitmask 0..7: statuses 0..3 return `swapEnabledByStatus: true`; statuses 4..7 return `swapEnabledByStatus: false`. Rejects status > 7 with `INVALID_STATUS`.
   - Accepts `creator_fee_on` values 0, 1, and 2; rejects values > 2 with `MALFORMED_CREATOR_FEE_FLAG`.
   - Accepts `enable_creator_fee` values 0 (false) and 1 (true); rejects values > 1 with `MALFORMED_CREATOR_FEE_FLAG`.
   - Accepts nonzero padding bytes in `padding_1` (391..397) and `padding` (413..637) without inventing a zero-padding requirement.
   - Verifies vault authority matches `GpMZbSM2GgvTKHJirzeGfMFoaZ8UR2X7F4v8vHTvxFbL`; rejects arbitrary authority with `VAULT_AUTHORITY_UNAUTHORIZED`.
   - Rejects uninitialized or frozen vaults with `VAULT_STATE_NOT_INITIALIZED`.
3. **Group 3: Address Validation & Target Binding (Anti-Manufacturing)**:
   - Rejects malformed base58 string for target pool, target mint, pool account, or vault accounts with `ADDRESS_MALFORMED`.
   - Allows PDA addresses that do not lie on the ed25519 curve (does not require addresses to be on-curve).
   - Rejects target candidate mint equal to WSOL with `CANDIDATE_MINT_IS_WSOL`.
   - Rejects `poolAccount.address !== target.poolAddress` with `POOL_ADDRESS_MISMATCH`.
   - Rejects candidate mint not matching either pool mint with `CANDIDATE_MINT_MISMATCH`.
   - Rejects non-WSOL pair (e.g. USDC/Bonk) with `NON_WSOL_PAIR`.
   - Rejects identical mints (`token_0_mint === token_1_mint`) with `IDENTICAL_MINTS`.
   - Rejects non-canonical mint ordering (`token_0_mint > token_1_mint` in raw byte order) with `CANONICAL_MINT_ORDER_VIOLATED`.
   - Rejects identical vault addresses (`token_0_vault === token_1_vault`) with `CONTRADICTORY_VAULTS`.
4. **Group 4: Bidirectional WSOL Orientation & Decimal Rules**:
   - **Case A**: Token 0 = Candidate Mint, Token 1 = WSOL. Asserts orientation is `TOKEN_0_BASE_WSOL_QUOTE`, base reserves map to token 0, quote reserves map to token 1, spot price equals `quoteDecimal / baseDecimal`.
   - **Case B**: Token 0 = WSOL, Token 1 = Candidate Mint. Asserts orientation is `TOKEN_1_BASE_WSOL_QUOTE`, base reserves map to token 1, quote reserves map to token 0, spot price equals `quoteDecimal / baseDecimal`.
   - Rejects pool where WSOL-side decimals !== 9 with `WSOL_DECIMALS_INVALID`.
   - Rejects pool where candidate decimals > 18 or LP decimals > 18 with `INVALID_DECIMALS`.
   - Preserves `swapActivationTimeSec` as exact `bigint` matching `open_time`.
5. **Group 5: Strict Token Scope & Token-2022 Rejection**:
   - Rejects pool where `token_0_program` is Token-2022 with `UNSUPPORTED_TOKEN_PROGRAM`.
   - Rejects pool where `token_1_program` is Token-2022 with `UNSUPPORTED_TOKEN_PROGRAM`.
   - Rejects vault account owned by Token-2022 program with `VAULT_OWNER_UNAUTHORIZED`.
6. **Group 6: Exact Integer Reserve Accounting, Insolvency & Large Integers**:
   - Verifies exact BigInt subtraction of `protocol_fees + fund_fees + creator_fees`.
   - Handles integers above 2^53 through u64 maximum (`18446744073709551615n`).
   - Rejects pool when vault balance is less than total fees with `INSOLVENT_RESERVES`.
   - Rejects pool when effective reserve is zero with `ZERO_EFFECTIVE_RESERVES`.
7. **Group 7: Vault Account Validation**:
   - Rejects vault buffer length !== 165 bytes with `VAULT_BUFFER_INVALID_LENGTH`.
   - Rejects `vault0Account.address !== token_0_vault` with `VAULT_ADDRESS_MISMATCH`.
   - Rejects `vault1Account.address !== token_1_vault` with `VAULT_ADDRESS_MISMATCH`.
   - Rejects vault mint mismatch against pool state with `VAULT_MINT_MISMATCH`.
8. **Group 8: Strict Slot Provenance & Coherence**:
   - Accepts when all slots match (`poolSlot === vault0Slot === vault1Slot`) with valid safe integers; reports `consistentSlot`.
   - Rejects when any slot is missing or undefined with `SLOT_PROVENANCE_MISSING_OR_INVALID`.
   - Rejects when any slot is negative, NaN, or non-integer with `SLOT_PROVENANCE_MISSING_OR_INVALID`.
   - Rejects when vault0 slot !== vault1 slot with `SLOT_DISCREPANCY`.
   - Rejects when pool slot !== vault slots with `SLOT_DISCREPANCY`.
9. **Group 9: Corrupted Layout & Edge Cases**:
   - Rejects corrupted or truncated internal layouts with `CORRUPTED_LAYOUT`.
10. **Group 10: Independent Literal Layout Vector**:
    - Verifies raw buffer constructed with literal byte offsets independent of parser constants and fixture generators.

##### 6. Implemented Module Contract: `DexScreenerCpmmCandidateMarketParser.ts`

- **Target Path**: [`backend/src/candidate-scanner/DexScreenerCpmmCandidateMarketParser.ts`](file:///u:/Projects/TopG/backend/src/candidate-scanner/DexScreenerCpmmCandidateMarketParser.ts)
- **Architectural Isolation Invariant**:
  The existing market parser [`DexScreenerSingleCandidateMarketParser.ts`](file:///u:/Projects/TopG/backend/src/candidate-scanner/DexScreenerSingleCandidateMarketParser.ts) and its explicit rejection of `"CPMM"` pools remain **completely active and unmodified**. The implemented `DexScreenerCpmmCandidateMarketParser.ts` is an isolated, pure parser specifically designed for CPMM market payloads. It remains completely unconnected to the coordinator, runner, and live admission paths until all CPMM stages have been implemented, tested, and reviewed.

- **Pure Entrypoint**:
  ```typescript
  export function parseDexScreenerCpmmTokenPairs(
    input: DexScreenerCpmmMarketParserInput,
  ): DexScreenerCpmmMarketParseResult;
  ```

**TypeScript Contract Specification**:

```typescript
import type { ScannedPoolRecord } from "./CandidateScannerTypes.js";
import type {
  RaydiumCpmmPoolStateSuccess,
  RaydiumCpmmPairOrientation,
} from "./RaydiumCpmmPoolStateAdapter.js";

export const WSOL_MINT_ADDRESS = "So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112";
const UNVERIFIED_AUTHORITY = "UNVERIFIED_AUTHORITY";
const UNSUPPORTED_RAYDIUM_LABELS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(["CLMM", "V3", "CL"]);

export interface DexScreenerCpmmMarketTarget {
  readonly poolAddress: string;
  readonly candidateMint: string;
}

export interface DexScreenerCpmmMarketParserInput {
  readonly json: unknown;
  readonly target: DexScreenerCpmmMarketTarget;
  readonly poolState: RaydiumCpmmPoolStateSuccess;
  readonly receivedAtMs?: number | null;
}

export type DexScreenerCpmmFieldClassification = "OBSERVED" | "UNAVAILABLE";

export type DexScreenerCpmmMarketParseFailureReason =
  | "MALFORMED_RESPONSE"
  | "NO_PAIRS"
  | "POOL_NOT_FOUND"
  | "AMBIGUOUS_POOL"
  | "INVALID_POOL_STATE"
  | "POOL_STATE_BINDING_MISMATCH"
  | "CHAIN_NOT_SOLANA"
  | "DEX_NOT_RAYDIUM"
  | "DEX_LABEL_NOT_CPMM"
  | "UNSUPPORTED_RAYDIUM_POOL_TYPE"
  | "UNSUPPORTED_ORIENTATION"
  | "BASE_MINT_MISMATCH"
  | "QUOTE_NOT_WSOL"
  | "SYMBOL_UNAVAILABLE"
  | "PRICE_NATIVE_INVALID"
  | "PRICE_USD_INVALID"
  | "LIQUIDITY_UNAVAILABLE"
  | "MARKET_CAP_UNAVAILABLE"
  | "CREATION_TIME_UNAVAILABLE"
  | "M5_TXNS_UNAVAILABLE"
  | "M5_VOLUME_UNAVAILABLE"
  | "RECEIVED_AT_INVALID";

export interface DexScreenerCpmmMarketProvenance {
  readonly provider: "DEXSCREENER";
  readonly pairAddress: string;
  readonly chainId: "solana";
  readonly dexId: "raydium";
  readonly labels: readonly string[];
  readonly onChainOrientation: RaydiumCpmmPairOrientation;
  readonly dexScreenerOrientation: "TOKEN_BASE_WSOL_QUOTE";
  readonly priceUnits: {
    readonly priceNative: "SOL_PER_TOKEN";
    readonly priceUsd: "USD_PER_TOKEN";
  };
  readonly creation: {
    readonly pairCreatedAtMs: number;
    readonly openTimeSec: number;
    readonly source: "DEXSCREENER_PAIR_CREATED_AT";
  };
  readonly onChainActivation: {
    readonly swapActivationTimeSec: bigint;
    readonly source: "RAYDIUM_CPMM_OPEN_TIME";
  };
  readonly metricWindows: {
    readonly providerRolling5m: "5m";
    readonly strategyQualifiedFlowWindow: "UNCONNECTED";
  };
  readonly priceObservations: {
    readonly spotPriceSolMarket: number;
    readonly spotPriceSolOnChainApprox: number;
    readonly comparisonPerformed: false;
  };
  readonly receivedAtMs: number | null;
  readonly classifications: Readonly<Record<string, DexScreenerCpmmFieldClassification>>;
}

export interface DexScreenerCpmmSpotInfo {
  readonly spotPriceSol: number;
  readonly spotPriceUsd: number;
  readonly liquidityUsd: number;
  readonly momentum5mBps?: number;
  readonly priceChange1hPct?: number;
}

export type DexScreenerCpmmMarketParseResult =
  | {
      readonly ok: true;
      readonly pool: ScannedPoolRecord;
      readonly spot: DexScreenerCpmmSpotInfo;
      readonly provenance: DexScreenerCpmmMarketProvenance;
    }
  | {
      readonly ok: false;
      readonly reason: DexScreenerCpmmMarketParseFailureReason;
    };
```

**Core Invariants and Behavioral Rules**:

1. **Structural Consistency with Caller-Supplied Pool State**:
   - Matching is strictly **structural consistency** with caller-supplied adapter output, **not cryptographic authentication**. Provider labels or matching public keys do not independently prove on-chain protocol identity or verified contract execution.
   - The parser requires an explicit, structurally verified `poolState: RaydiumCpmmPoolStateSuccess` input.
   - The parser verifies:
     - `target.poolAddress === poolState.poolAddress`
     - `target.candidateMint === poolState.candidateMint`
     - `poolState.wsolMint === WSOL_MINT_ADDRESS`
     - `poolState.orientation` is a recognized orientation (`TOKEN_0_BASE_WSOL_QUOTE` or `TOKEN_1_BASE_WSOL_QUOTE`)
     - `poolState.spotPriceSolApprox` is a finite non-negative number and `swapActivationTimeSec` is a bigint.
       If target and poolState disagree, or poolState is not a valid recognized state, the parser fails closed deterministically with `POOL_STATE_BINDING_MISMATCH` or `INVALID_POOL_STATE`.
   - The matching DexScreener pair must satisfy:
     - `pair.pairAddress === target.poolAddress`
     - `pair.baseToken.address === target.candidateMint`
     - `pair.quoteToken.address === WSOL_MINT_ADDRESS`
     - `pair.chainId === "solana"`
     - `pair.dexId === "raydium"`
     - `pair.labels` must explicitly include `"CPMM"` (case-insensitive); if missing, fail closed with `DEX_LABEL_NOT_CPMM`.

2. **Source-Backed API Facts vs. Adopted Interpretations**:
   - Source-backed official reference: [`https://docs.dexscreener.com/api/reference`](https://docs.dexscreener.com/api/reference) defines `baseToken`, `quoteToken`, `priceNative`, `priceUsd`, `txns.m5.buys`, `txns.m5.sells`, `volume.m5`, `liquidity.usd`, `marketCap`, and `pairCreatedAt`.
   - Adopted interpretations marked as unverified assumptions:
     - Interpreting `priceNative` as SOL per candidate token assumes DexScreener's quote token native currency convention holds.
     - Interpreting `buys` and `sells` as candidate purchases and candidate sales relies on standard exchange convention where buy = buying base token with quote token.
   - Synthetic unit tests verify structural transformations and fail-closed handling, **not external provider semantics**.

3. **Restrictive CPMM Label Policy & Orientation**:
   - Requiring `"CPMM"` in `labels` is this parser's restrictive policy, not an API guarantee.
   - Rejects conflicting unsupported Raydium labels (`"CLMM"`, `"V3"`, `"CL"`) with `UNSUPPORTED_RAYDIUM_POOL_TYPE`.
   - Supports only candidate-base and WSOL-quote provider orientation (`"TOKEN_BASE_WSOL_QUOTE"`).
   - Rejects reversed pairs (`base = WSOL`, `quote = candidate`) fail-closed with `UNSUPPORTED_ORIENTATION` without inversion.
   - Supports either on-chain token ordering (`TOKEN_0_BASE_WSOL_QUOTE` vs `TOKEN_1_BASE_WSOL_QUOTE`) independently, preserving both on-chain and provider orientations in provenance.

4. **Separate Price Observations**:
   - Records the provider spot price (`spotPriceSolMarket`) and on-chain pool-state spot approximation (`spotPriceSolOnChainApprox`) separately under `priceObservations` with `comparisonPerformed: false`.
   - Does not assert a discrepancy threshold or claim simultaneous/fresh observations.

5. **Creation vs. Swap Activation Time & Flow Decoupling**:
   - Preserves provider-reported `pairCreatedAt` (epoch milliseconds) and derived `openTimeSec` with provenance `source: "DEXSCREENER_PAIR_CREATED_AT"`.
   - Does not claim `pairCreatedAt` proves on-chain creation or first indexing time.
   - Preserves `swapActivationTimeSec` separately with provenance `source: "RAYDIUM_CPMM_OPEN_TIME"`; **never substitutes swap activation time for creation time**.
   - Preserves 5-minute rolling metrics (`buys5m`, `sells5m`, `volume5mUsd`, `txCount5m`) separately from strategy qualified flow. Never divides by 5.
   - Note: In the strategy's rolling trade flow tracker, $\le 15\text{s}$ represents **cutoff freshness** (maximum age of latest observation), not a permitted notification gap.

6. **Numeric Validations (No FDV Substitution)**:
   - Prices (`priceNative`, `priceUsd`) must be positive finite decimal strings.
   - `liquidity.usd`, `marketCap`, and `volume.m5` must be finite non-negative numbers.
   - **Never substitutes FDV for missing marketCap**: responses with FDV but missing marketCap fail closed with `MARKET_CAP_UNAVAILABLE`.
   - `buys5m`, `sells5m`, and their sum (`txCount5m`) must be non-negative safe integers.

7. **Date Formatting & Derived-Value Validation**:
   - Validates supplied `receivedAtMs` before date formatting: non-integer, negative, `NaN`, `Infinity`, or out-of-range values fail closed with typed refusal `RECEIVED_AT_INVALID` without throwing runtime exceptions.
   - Optional price change conversions (`priceChange.m5` to `momentum5mBps`) must never produce infinite, `NaN`, or unsafe derived values; non-finite or overflowing values remain `UNAVAILABLE`.

8. **Security Fields Boundary & Immutability**:
   - Security fields (`decimals: 0`, `lpBurnPct: null`, `mintAuthority`, `freezeAuthority`) remain explicitly `UNAVAILABLE`.
   - The legacy `decimals: 0` placeholder is not described as observed token decimals.
   - Inputs are never mutated; newly constructed outputs and provenance objects are deeply frozen (`Object.freeze`).

**Exhaustive Refusal Taxonomy**:

| Refusal Reason                  | Trigger Condition                                                                                        |
| :------------------------------ | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `MALFORMED_RESPONSE`            | Input `json` is not an object, `target` is not a record, or `pairs` is not an array.                     |
| `NO_PAIRS`                      | `pairs` array is empty (`length === 0`).                                                                 |
| `POOL_NOT_FOUND`                | No pair in `pairs` matches `target.poolAddress`.                                                         |
| `AMBIGUOUS_POOL`                | Multiple pairs in `pairs` match `target.poolAddress`.                                                    |
| `INVALID_POOL_STATE`            | `poolState` is null/failed, orientation unrecognized, spot price invalid, or activation time not bigint. |
| `POOL_STATE_BINDING_MISMATCH`   | Target address or mint does not match supplied `poolState` (`poolAddress`, `candidateMint`, `wsolMint`). |
| `CHAIN_NOT_SOLANA`              | `pair.chainId !== "solana"`.                                                                             |
| `DEX_NOT_RAYDIUM`               | `pair.dexId !== "raydium"`.                                                                              |
| `DEX_LABEL_NOT_CPMM`            | `pair.labels` does not include `"CPMM"` (case-insensitive).                                              |
| `UNSUPPORTED_RAYDIUM_POOL_TYPE` | `pair.labels` contains unsupported Raydium labels (e.g. `"CLMM"`, `"V3"`, `"CL"`).                       |

| `QUOTE_NOT_WSOL`                | `pair.quoteToken.address !== WSOL_MINT_ADDRESS`.                                                         |

| `LIQUIDITY_UNAVAILABLE`         | `pair.liquidity.usd` is missing, non-numeric, negative, NaN, or infinite.                                |
| `MARKET_CAP_UNAVAILABLE`        | `pair.marketCap` is missing, non-numeric, negative, NaN, or infinite (FDV not substituted).              |

3. **Handler order** (both entry points), in sequence:
   1. Check the pool status bit and `open_time`.
   2. Compute the transfer fees (zero for SPL Token mints).

   4. Check slippage.
   5. `update_fees`.
   6. `emit!(SwapEvent)`.
   7. `require_gte!(constant_after, constant_before)`.

   10. Update the observation and `recent_epoch`.

   The event is emitted before both transfers, so a log line alone never establishes execution.

4. **Exactly two transfers in a successful SPL swap**: both helpers return early without a CPI when `amount == 0`, but a successful swap never has a zero amount.
   - `swap_base_input` requires `actual_amount_in > 0` and `amount_received > 0`.
   - `swap_base_output` requires `amount_out_received > 0` and `input_amount > 0`.
   - So a successful swap issues exactly two `transfer_checked` CPIs, input first and then output.
   - The Anchor wrapper calls `spl_token_2022::instruction::transfer_checked(program, from, mint, to, authority, &[], amount, decimals)` with an empty multisig list (4 accounts) through `invoke_signed`.

###### C. Signer and Privilege Rules (Corrected)

1. **What `Signer<'info>` means**: Anchor checks the account's `is_signer` flag in the CPMM invocation it receives. It does not mean "transaction signer" or "fee payer", and `payer` is not `mut`.
2. **Solana privilege rule** (`core/cpi/cpi-execution.mdx`, enforced in `prepare_next_instruction`): an account can be a signer in the callee only if:
   - it was already a signer in the caller; or
   - it is a PDA derived from the calling program's seeds and signed with `invoke_signed`.

   Privileges cannot escalate, but can be reduced. PDA signing involves no cryptographic signature: the runtime re-derives the address from the seeds and the calling program ID.

3. **Top-level CPMM swap** (height 1): the signer flag comes from the message.
   - **Rule**: `payer` must be a static key with index < `header.numRequiredSignatures`. Lookup tables cannot load signers ("Only non-signer accounts can be loaded from a lookup table").
   - **Fee payer**: `payer` need not be the fee payer (static index 0). It may be any required signer, writable or read-only.
   - **Refusal**: a successful transaction that breaks this rule contradicts the runtime and is refused as `CONFLICTING_EVIDENCE` (`PAYER_NOT_MESSAGE_SIGNER`).
4. **Routed CPMM swap** (height ≥ 2): the immediate caller makes `payer` a signer, either by passing through an account it received as a signer or by signing for its own PDA with `invoke_signed`. The JSON inner instruction carries no signer flags.
   - **Rule**: the decoder must not require `payer` to be a transaction signer or the fee payer, and performs no signer check. Transaction success is the evidence that the runtime accepted the privileges.
5. **Transfer authorities**:
   - the input transfer's authority is `payer`, whose signer privilege is passed through from the CPMM invocation;
   - the output transfer's authority is the CPMM authority PDA, signed by CPMM itself with `invoke_signed` at the CPMM-to-Token invocation.
   - The decoder checks only that each authority account equals the expected identity (item F).
6. **Router identity**: in routed trades `payer` and the user token accounts may belong to a router or its PDA, not the end user. The decoder reports pool flow, not trader identity.

###### D. Failure Semantics (Corrected)

- **No catching**: the `invoke` documentation states that it "will not return if the called program returns anything other than success", that if the callee errors or aborts "the entire transaction will immediately fail", and that "control will not return to the caller". A router cannot catch a failed CPI; Ethereum-style try/catch does not exist here.
- **Consequence**: in a transaction with `meta.err === null`, every recorded invocation, top-level or inner, completed successfully. Inner swaps need no log-based proof of completion.
- **Removed**: `INVOCATION_FAILED` and the rule refusing inner swaps without logs.
- **Contradiction rule**: a `Program <id> failed` log line in a transaction with `meta.err === null` is a contradiction and is refused as `CONFLICTING_EVIDENCE`.
- **Reentrancy** (`core/cpi/index.mdx`): direct self-recursion (A→A) is allowed; indirect reentrancy (A→B→A) is not. CPMM's swap path makes no CPMM self-call. A CPMM child of a CPMM swap frame is refused by the two-children rule.

###### E. Call-Tree Reconstruction and Matching Algorithm

**Facts used** (`gettransaction.mdx`, `cpi-execution.mdx`):

- `meta.innerInstructions` groups are keyed by top-level instruction index and list that instruction's CPIs, at every depth, in execution order.
- Inner instructions carry `stackHeight` ("`u32 | null`, when reported"); `innerInstructions` and `logMessages` "may be `null` or omitted when unavailable".
- Stack height 1 is the top-level instruction, and each CPI adds 1.
- The maximum height is 5, or 9 with SIMD-0268.

**Acceptance and refusal rule for a target swap frame** `S` at height `H`:

- `S` must have exactly two descendants, and both must be its direct children at height `H + 1`, in this order: the input `TransferChecked`, then the output `TransferChecked`.
- Refused:
  - zero descendants, including a CPMM entry that is the last instruction of its group (the former "final inner instruction" exception is withdrawn);
  - one, or three or more, descendants;
  - any grandchild at height `H + 2` or deeper;
  - children in the wrong order;
  - a child to any other program.
- This is `CONFLICTING_EVIDENCE` (`SWAP_FRAME_SHAPE_INVALID`).

**Height evidence**: every inner instruction in the transaction must carry an integer `stackHeight` from 2 to 9.

- A missing, `null`, non-integer, out-of-range or level-skipping height makes the whole transaction `UNRESOLVED_EVIDENCE` (`UNSUPPORTED_CALL_TREE`). Boundaries are never inferred from logs or position.
- A top-level `stackHeight`, if present, must be 1 or `null`.
- Heights 6–9 are accepted structurally, because the decoder cannot know whether SIMD-0268 is active. A height above 5 on a runtime without it would be rejected by the runtime anyway, so it cannot appear in a genuine successful transaction.

**Decoder input bounds** (decoder policy, not runtime facts; exceeding any of them gives `UNRESOLVED_EVIDENCE` with `EVIDENCE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`):

| Bound                                 | Limit        | Basis                                       |
| ------------------------------------- | ------------ | ------------------------------------------- |
| Resolved account keys                 | 256          | Decoder policy                              |
| Top-level instructions                | 64           | Decoder policy                              |
| Inner instructions in the transaction | 1,024        | Decoder policy                              |
| Instruction data per instruction      | 10,240 bytes | The documented maximum CPI instruction data |
| Log lines                             | 10,000       | Decoder policy                              |

Every loop below is linear in these bounds.

**Pseudocode**:

```text
decode(payload, pool: RaydiumCpmmPoolStateSuccess, opts: { receiptTimestampMs }):
  1  validate opts.receiptTimestampMs (item H)            else UNRESOLVED INVALID_RECEIPT_TIMESTAMP
  2  validate pool (ok === true, canonical distinct keys, WSOL quote, quoteDecimals 9,
     integer baseDecimals 0..255, known orientation)       else UNRESOLVED INVALID_POOL_CONTEXT
  3  validate envelope (item I): signature[0], slot, version, header, meta object,
     meta.err present                                      else UNRESOLVED (specific reason)
  4  if meta.err !== null: return TRANSACTION_FAILED        (no events; not zero-swap evidence)
  5  A := resolveAccounts(payload)                           (item I; strict, no compaction)
  6  T := top-level instructions; validate each: programIdIndex < |A|, account indexes < |A|,
     data is base58 and decodes to <= 10,240 bytes, stackHeight in {absent, null, 1}
  7  if pool.poolAddress not in A: return NO_MATCHING_SWAPS (TARGET_POOL_NOT_REFERENCED)
     -- a swap must pass pool_state; an account absent from the transaction cannot be touched
  8  if meta.innerInstructions is not an array: return UNRESOLVED INNER_INSTRUCTIONS_UNAVAILABLE
  9  validate groups: integer index in [0, |T|), unique, non-empty instructions; validate every
     inner entry as in step 6, with stackHeight an integer in [2, 9]
 10  for each outer index o in ascending order:
       nodes := [ {o, pos: 0, h: 1, ix: T[o]} ] ++ [ {o, pos: k+1, h: e.stackHeight, ix: e}
                                                      for k, e in group(o) (or none) ]
       stack := [nodes[0]]
       for n in nodes[1..]:
         while top(stack).h >= n.h: pop(stack)
         if n.h != top(stack).h + 1: return UNRESOLVED UNSUPPORTED_CALL_TREE (height skip)
         n.parent := top(stack); top(stack).children.append(n); push(stack, n)
       -- preorder positions with depths determine the ordered tree uniquely;
       -- descendants(n) = the nodes after n up to the first node with h <= n.h
 11  cpmmNodes := every node whose program A[ix.programIdIndex] == CPMM, in execution order
     (o ascending, pos ascending)
 12  for n in cpmmNodes:
       d := data(n)
       if |d| < 8: return UNRESOLVED MALFORMED_INSTRUCTION_DATA
       if d[0..8] in {SWAP_BASE_INPUT, SWAP_BASE_OUTPUT}:
         if |accounts(n)| < 13: return UNRESOLVED MALFORMED_INSTRUCTION_DATA
         if accounts(n)[3] != pool.poolAddress:
           if accounts(n) contains pool.poolAddress, base vault or quote vault:
             return UNRESOLVED IDENTITY_MISMATCH
           nonTargetSwaps += 1; continue
         r := validateTargetSwap(n)                          (items C, F, G)
         if r is a refusal: return UNRESOLVED r.reason       (never a partial result)
         candidates.append(r)
       else if accounts(n) contains pool.poolAddress, base vault or quote vault:
         return UNRESOLVED UNSUPPORTED_INSTRUCTION           (e.g. deposit or withdraw)
       else: otherCpmmInstructions += 1
 13  logStatus := corroborate(meta.logMessages, cpmmNodes, candidates)   (item G)
     if logStatus is a refusal: return UNRESOLVED CONFLICTING_EVIDENCE
 14  if candidates is empty: return NO_MATCHING_SWAPS (diagnostics: counts, logStatus)
 15  validate blockTime (item H)                              else UNRESOLVED (reason)
 16  return SWAP_DECODED with one frozen TradeEvent per candidate, in execution order

validateTargetSwap(n):
  |data(n)| == 24 (else MALFORMED_INSTRUCTION_DATA); |accounts(n)| == 13 (else UNSUPPORTED_ACCOUNT_COUNT)
  apply the identity and binding rules of item F
  if n.h == 1: messageIndex(accounts(n)[0]) < header.numRequiredSignatures
               (else CONFLICTING_EVIDENCE PAYER_NOT_MESSAGE_SIGNER)
  if n.h >= 2: no signer check (item C.4)
  require |descendants(n)| == 2 and |children(n)| == 2 (else CONFLICTING_EVIDENCE SWAP_FRAME_SHAPE_INVALID)
  inT := decodeTransferChecked(children(n)[0]); outT := decodeTransferChecked(children(n)[1])
  bind inT and outT (item F); apply the amount rules (item G)
  return { node: n, discriminator, params, inT, outT }
```

- **Siblings**: two CPMM swaps under one router are separate children of the router node, each with its own two children. A router's own transfers between or around them are outside both subtrees and are ignored.
- **Repeated program IDs**: there is no "next CPMM instruction" heuristic. Every CPMM node is located by its tree position, and top-level and routed CPMM swaps in one transaction are handled uniformly.
- **Unrelated programs**: transfers or instructions outside a target swap's subtree are never counted. The target vaults can only be debited with the CPMM authority PDA, which only CPMM can sign.

###### F. `TransferChecked` Binding

Both children must be invocations of the SPL Token program `TokenkegQfeZyiNwAJbNbGKPFXCWuBvf9Ss623VQ5DA` with:

- data exactly 10 bytes: `[12, amount u64 LE, decimals u8]`;
- exactly 4 accounts: `[source, mint, destination, authority]`, with no multisig signers.

Plain `Transfer` (tag 3), other data lengths and other account counts are refused.

| Check           | Input transfer (child 0)                        | Output transfer (child 1)                                       |
| --------------- | ----------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Invoked program | equals swap account 8, which must be SPL Token  | equals swap account 9, which must be SPL Token                  |
| `source`        | swap account 4 (`input_token_account`)          | swap account 7 (`output_vault`)                                 |
| `mint`          | swap account 10 (`input_token_mint`)            | swap account 11 (`output_token_mint`)                           |
| `destination`   | swap account 6 (`input_vault`)                  | swap account 5 (`output_token_account`)                         |
| `authority`     | swap account 0 (`payer`)                        | swap account 1 (`GpMZbSM2GgvTKHJirzeGfMFoaZ8UR2X7F4v8vHTvxFbL`) |
| `decimals`      | the input mint's decimals from the pool context | the output mint's decimals from the pool context                |
| `amount`        | greater than 0                                  | greater than 0                                                  |

Pool binding of the swap accounts:

- **Authority and programs**: account 1 must be the CPMM authority PDA. Accounts 8 and 9 must be SPL Token; Token-2022 gives `UNSUPPORTED_TOKEN_PROGRAM`.
- **Vaults**: `{account 6, account 7}` must equal `{baseVaultAddress, quoteVaultAddress}`, and the two must differ (`VAULT_MISMATCH`).
- **Mints**: each of accounts 10 and 11 must be the mint of its vault per the pool context (`MINT_MISMATCH`). Exactly one side is WSOL and the other is the candidate (`NON_WSOL_PAIR` otherwise).
- **User token accounts**: accounts 4 and 5 must differ from each other and from both vaults (`CONFLICTING_EVIDENCE`).
- **Not bound**: accounts 2 (`amm_config`) and 12 (`observation_state`) cannot be checked, because `RaydiumCpmmPoolStateSuccess` does not expose them. The program enforces both, so they are recorded as an uncertainty (item 10), not invented.

###### G. Amounts, Event Consistency and Log Corroboration

1. **Executed amounts**: these come from the two transfers only. Instruction parameters and pre/post token balances are never recorded as executed amounts. All amounts are exact `bigint` atomic units, up to `2^64 − 1`.
2. **Parameter consistency (SPL Token, no transfer fee)**:
   - `swap_base_input`: `inT.amount == amount_in` and `outT.amount ≥ minimum_amount_out`;
   - `swap_base_output`: `outT.amount == amount_out` and `inT.amount ≤ max_amount_in`.
   - Any violation is `CONFLICTING_EVIDENCE`.
3. **Log classification**:
   - **`UNAVAILABLE`**: `logMessages` is absent or `null`. Decoding proceeds from instructions alone.
   - **`INCOMPLETE`**: the logs fail to parse as a LIFO-balanced stack, end with open frames, or contain a `Log truncated` line. Decoding proceeds, and nothing from the logs is used.
   - **`COMPLETE`** requires all of the following:
     - every `Program <id> invoke [d]` has `d` equal to the stack depth plus 1, and every `Program <id> success` closes the frame on top of the stack with the same program ID;
     - no `failed` line (one is refused under item D);
     - the stack is empty at the end, and there is no truncation marker.
4. **Positional correspondence (`COMPLETE` logs only)**:
   - **CPMM frames**: let `L` be the CPMM `invoke` frames in log order. Require `|L| == |cpmmNodes|`, and for each `k`, `depth(L[k]) == cpmmNodes[k].h`. The program IDs of the direct child `invoke` lines of `L[k]` must equal those of `cpmmNodes[k].children`, in order.
   - **Scope**: only CPMM frames and their direct children are compared. Other programs' log behaviour (for example precompiles) is not assumed.
   - **Refusal**: any mismatch is `CONFLICTING_EVIDENCE` (`LOG_TRACE_MISMATCH`).
5. **`SwapEvent` consistency** (for each target swap, when the logs are `COMPLETE`):
   - The `Program data:` lines emitted directly in `L[k]` (not in child frames) must be exactly one valid `SwapEvent`: 170 bytes, the correct discriminator and strict booleans. Zero, more than one, or any other `Program data` line in that frame is `CONFLICTING_EVIDENCE`.
   - It must agree with the instruction and transfers:
     - `pool_id`, `input_mint` and `output_mint` equal swap accounts 3, 10 and 11;
     - `base_input` is 1 for `swap_base_input` and 0 for `swap_base_output`;
     - `input_transfer_fee` and `output_transfer_fee` are 0;
     - `input_amount == inT.amount` and `output_amount == outT.amount`.
   - The vault-before, trade-fee and creator-fee fields are recorded as diagnostics, not checked: they need pool state that the decoder does not have.
6. **Role of logs**: logs never establish execution or amounts. They can only contradict, which refuses, or corroborate. Each result reports `logCorroboration: "CORROBORATED" | "UNAVAILABLE" | "INCOMPLETE"`.

###### H. Timestamp Provenance and Receipt-Time Injection (Corrected)

- **Event time from `blockTime` only**: `blockTime` (documented as `i64 | null`: estimated production time in Unix seconds) is used only if it is a number with `Number.isSafeInteger(blockTime)`, `blockTime > 0` and `blockTime ≤ 9_007_199_254_740`, so that `blockTime * 1000` is a safe integer.
  - Absent or `null`: `MISSING_UPSTREAM_TIMESTAMP`.
  - Present but fractional, non-finite, non-positive, a string or too large: `INVALID_UPSTREAM_TIMESTAMP`.
  - There is no flooring or rounding.
- **Derived fields**: `blockTimeSec = blockTime`, `eventTimestampMs = blockTime * 1000` (an exact integer), and `timestampProvenance = "ON_CHAIN_BLOCK_TIME"`. Provenance is fixed by that source: the decoder never emits `HOST_OBSERVED` or `SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE`, and there is no `fallbackProvenance` option.
- **Receipt time**: `receiptTimestampMs` is a required injected input (the host's receipt time in integer milliseconds). It must be a safe integer > 0, otherwise `INVALID_RECEIPT_TIMESTAMP`. The decoder has no clock and no default.
- **What the decoder does not judge**: receipt time against block time. Block time is an estimate, and the tracker's existing future-dating and contradiction checks apply at ingestion.
- **No events, no block time needed**: a `NO_MATCHING_SWAPS` or `TRANSACTION_FAILED` result carries no events, and does not require `blockTime`.
- **Not repeated from AMM v4**: the AMM v4 decoder (`RaydiumAmmV4SwapDecoder.ts`) still has the `fallbackProvenance`, `Math.floor` and clock-default pattern. It is unchanged here, and the CPMM decoder must not copy it.

###### I. Supported Encoding, Versions and Account Resolution

- **Encoding**: only `getTransaction` with `encoding: "json"` (compiled instructions; base58 data; account keys as strings).
  - `accountKeys` entries that are objects (`jsonParsed`), instructions carrying `programId` or `parsed` instead of `programIdIndex`, and data given as bytes or arrays all give `UNSUPPORTED_ENCODING`.
  - Synthetic tests build the `json` shape.
- **Version**: the `version` field is required, because it is omitted when `maxSupportedTransactionVersion` is unset and that would make legacy and v0 indistinguishable.
  - Accepted: `"legacy"` and `0`.
  - Refused (`UNSUPPORTED_TRANSACTION_VERSION`): `1` (the documented v1 format is not yet reviewed against a v1 JSON fixture) and any other value.
- **Header and signatures**: `message.header` is required, with integers `1 ≤ numRequiredSignatures ≤ |static keys|` and read-only counts that fit. `signatures.length` must equal `numRequiredSignatures`, and `signatures[0]` must be a canonical 64-byte base58 signature.
- **Resolution**: the resolved list is the static keys, then `loadedAddresses.writable`, then `loadedAddresses.readonly`, in that order.
  - Every key must be canonical 32-byte base58, and there must be no duplicates.
  - Never filtered or compacted: instruction indexes refer to exact positions.
  - Legacy transactions must have no `addressTableLookups` and either no `loadedAddresses` or both lists empty.
  - v0 transactions must have `addressTableLookups` (possibly empty) and `loadedAddresses`, and the list lengths must equal the summed `writableIndexes` and `readonlyIndexes` lengths.
  - Any violation is `MALFORMED_ACCOUNT_KEYS`.
- **Malformed evidence is global**: any malformation anywhere (keys, indexes, data, groups, heights, logs that are `COMPLETE` but contradictory) refuses the whole transaction, even far from the target pool, because a malformed trace can hide a target swap. The only shortcuts are step 7 (target pool not referenced) and step 4 (transaction failed). Both apply only after the envelope and account list are valid.

###### J. Classification, Stable Event IDs and `TradeEvent` Mapping

- **Side** is relative to the candidate, independent of orientation:
  - input WSOL and output candidate is `BUY`, with `solAmount = inT.amount` and `tokenAmount = outT.amount`;
  - input candidate and output WSOL is `SELL`, with `tokenAmount = inT.amount` and `solAmount = outT.amount`.
- **Identifiers**: `outerInstructionIndex = o` and `swapIndex = pos`, where `pos` is 0 for a top-level swap and `k + 1` for the `k`-th entry of the inner group. `eventId = ${signature}:${o}:${pos}`.
  - This matches the tracker's canonical key `(signature, outerInstructionIndex, swapIndex)`.
  - The ID is unique within a transaction and depends only on the instruction trace: removing logs, decoding against another pool or adding non-target swaps elsewhere does not change it.
- **`TradeEvent` fields** (the existing interface in `RollingTradeFlowTracker.ts`, unchanged): `poolId = pool.poolAddress`, `tokenMint = pool.candidateMint`, `slot`, `blockTimeSec`, `eventTimestampMs`, `receiptTimestampMs` and `timestampProvenance` per item H, and `tokenAmount` and `solAmount` as `bigint`.
- **Immutability**: events and arrays are deep-frozen, and the input payload is not mutated.

###### K. Outcome Union (Assessed and Corrected)

The four-way union is kept, with each status's reasons partitioned and its meaning made exact:

| Status                | `ok`  | Meaning                                                                                                                                                                                 | Events    |
| --------------------- | ----- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------- |
| `SWAP_DECODED`        | true  | The transaction succeeded, the full trace was validated, and every target swap was decoded. Results are never partial: one refused target swap refuses the transaction.                 | 1 or more |
| `NO_MATCHING_SWAPS`   | true  | The transaction succeeded and either the target pool is not among its accounts (step 7) or the validated trace contains no CPMM swap or other CPMM instruction touching the target pool | 0         |
| `TRANSACTION_FAILED`  | false | `meta.err !== null` with a valid envelope. A record of failure only: **not** zero-swap evidence for PAPER (item L).                                                                     | 0         |
| `UNRESOLVED_EVIDENCE` | false | Anything else. Never converted to `NO_MATCHING_SWAPS`.                                                                                                                                  | 0         |

`UNRESOLVED_EVIDENCE` reasons:

- **Inputs**: `INVALID_PAYLOAD`, `INVALID_POOL_CONTEXT`, `INVALID_RECEIPT_TIMESTAMP`.
- **Envelope and encoding**: `MISSING_SIGNATURE`, `INVALID_SLOT`, `METADATA_UNAVAILABLE` (formerly `TRANSACTION_NOT_SUCCESSFUL`), `UNSUPPORTED_ENCODING`, `UNSUPPORTED_TRANSACTION_VERSION`, `MALFORMED_ACCOUNT_KEYS`.
- **Trace**: `INNER_INSTRUCTIONS_UNAVAILABLE`, `UNSUPPORTED_CALL_TREE`, `MALFORMED_INSTRUCTION_DATA`, `EVIDENCE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`.
- **Timestamps**: `MISSING_UPSTREAM_TIMESTAMP`, `INVALID_UPSTREAM_TIMESTAMP`.
- **Instruction and pool binding**: `UNSUPPORTED_INSTRUCTION`, `UNSUPPORTED_ACCOUNT_COUNT`, `UNSUPPORTED_TOKEN_PROGRAM`, `IDENTITY_MISMATCH`, `VAULT_MISMATCH`, `MINT_MISMATCH`, `NON_WSOL_PAIR`.
- **Contradiction**: `CONFLICTING_EVIDENCE`, with a fixed detail code: `PAYER_NOT_MESSAGE_SIGNER`, `SWAP_FRAME_SHAPE_INVALID`, `TRANSFER_BINDING_INVALID`, `AMOUNT_PARAMETER_MISMATCH`, `LOG_TRACE_MISMATCH`, `EVENT_MISMATCH` or `FAILED_LOG_IN_SUCCESSFUL_TRANSACTION`.

Removed: `INVOCATION_FAILED` (item D), and `TRANSACTION_FAILED` and `NO_MATCHING_SWAPS_FOUND` as `UNRESOLVED_EVIDENCE` reasons.

Diagnostics on `ok` results: `topLevelInstructions`, `innerInstructions`, `cpmmInvocations`, `targetSwaps`, `nonTargetSwaps`, `otherCpmmInstructions`, `logCorroboration`, and `shortcut` (`"TARGET_POOL_NOT_REFERENCED"` or `null`).

###### L. Failed-Transaction Validation and PAPER Zero-Swap Policy (Deferred)

- **AMM v4-specific validator**: `ValidatedFailedTransactionEvidence.ts` imports `RAYDIUM_AMM_V4_PROGRAM_ID` and `decodeRaydiumTransactionSwaps` and checks the AMM v4 program ID, so CPMM cannot use it unchanged.
- **Deferred**: a CPMM-aware validator and any PAPER zero-swap integration are outside this decoder's scope, and the AMM v4 validator and policies stay unchanged.
- **Until then**: `TRANSACTION_FAILED` and `NO_MATCHING_SWAPS` are decoder results only, and must not be fed into any zero-swap or coverage policy.

###### M. Proposed TypeScript Contract

```typescript
import type { TradeEvent } from "./RollingTradeFlowTracker.js";
import type { RaydiumCpmmPoolStateSuccess } from "./RaydiumCpmmPoolStateAdapter.js";

export const RAYDIUM_CPMM_PROGRAM_ID = "CPMMoo8L3F4NbTegBCKVNunggL7H1ZpdTHKxQB5qKP1C";
export const RAYDIUM_CPMM_AUTHORITY = "GpMZbSM2GgvTKHJirzeGfMFoaZ8UR2X7F4v8vHTvxFbL";
export const RAYDIUM_CPMM_SOURCE_COMMIT = "b3187ae53a1b95a201f855a59024a12ca8f5b51a";
export const CPMM_SWAP_BASE_INPUT = "8fbe5adac41e33de";
export const CPMM_SWAP_BASE_OUTPUT = "37d96256a34ab4ad";
export const CPMM_SWAP_EVENT = "40c6cde8260871e2";

export interface DecodeCpmmSwapOptions {
  /** Host receipt time, integer milliseconds; required (the decoder has no clock). */
  readonly receiptTimestampMs: number;
}

export type CpmmLogCorroboration = "CORROBORATED" | "UNAVAILABLE" | "INCOMPLETE";

export interface CpmmDecodeDiagnostics {
  readonly topLevelInstructions: number;
  readonly innerInstructions: number;
  readonly cpmmInvocations: number;
  readonly targetSwaps: number;
  readonly nonTargetSwaps: number;
  readonly otherCpmmInstructions: number;
  readonly logCorroboration: CpmmLogCorroboration;
  readonly shortcut: "TARGET_POOL_NOT_REFERENCED" | null;
}

export type CpmmUnresolvedReason =
  | "INVALID_PAYLOAD"
  | "INVALID_POOL_CONTEXT"
  | "INVALID_RECEIPT_TIMESTAMP"
  | "MISSING_SIGNATURE"
  | "INVALID_SLOT"
  | "METADATA_UNAVAILABLE"
  | "UNSUPPORTED_ENCODING"
  | "UNSUPPORTED_TRANSACTION_VERSION"
  | "MALFORMED_ACCOUNT_KEYS"
  | "INNER_INSTRUCTIONS_UNAVAILABLE"
  | "UNSUPPORTED_CALL_TREE"
  | "MALFORMED_INSTRUCTION_DATA"
  | "EVIDENCE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED"
  | "MISSING_UPSTREAM_TIMESTAMP"
  | "INVALID_UPSTREAM_TIMESTAMP"
  | "UNSUPPORTED_INSTRUCTION"
  | "UNSUPPORTED_ACCOUNT_COUNT"
  | "UNSUPPORTED_TOKEN_PROGRAM"
  | "IDENTITY_MISMATCH"
  | "VAULT_MISMATCH"
  | "MINT_MISMATCH"
  | "NON_WSOL_PAIR"
  | "CONFLICTING_EVIDENCE";

export type DecodeRaydiumCpmmTransactionResult =
  | {
      readonly ok: true;
      readonly status: "SWAP_DECODED";
      readonly signature: string;
      readonly slot: number;
      readonly events: readonly TradeEvent[];
      readonly diagnostics: CpmmDecodeDiagnostics;
    }
  | {
      readonly ok: true;
      readonly status: "NO_MATCHING_SWAPS";
      readonly signature: string;
      readonly slot: number;
      readonly events: readonly [];
      readonly diagnostics: CpmmDecodeDiagnostics;
    }
  | {
      readonly ok: false;
      readonly status: "TRANSACTION_FAILED";
      readonly signature: string;
      readonly slot: number;
      readonly events: readonly [];
    }
  | {
      readonly ok: false;
      readonly status: "UNRESOLVED_EVIDENCE";
      readonly reason: CpmmUnresolvedReason;
      readonly detail: string | null;
      readonly message: string;
      readonly signature?: string | undefined;
      readonly slot?: number | undefined;
      readonly events: readonly [];
    };

/** Pure: payload is validated at runtime as the `encoding: "json"` getTransaction shape. */
export function decodeRaydiumCpmmTransactionSwaps(
  payload: unknown,
  pool: RaydiumCpmmPoolStateSuccess,
  options: DecodeCpmmSwapOptions,
): DecodeRaydiumCpmmTransactionResult;
```

Reuse:

- **Interfaces**: `TradeEvent`, `TradeSide` and `TradeTimestampProvenance` unchanged, and `RaydiumCpmmPoolStateSuccess` as the pool context, so there is no parallel pool type.
- **Helpers**: `isCanonicalSolanaBase58` and the strict `u64` reader may be reused.
- **Not reused**: the AMM v4 `DecodableTransactionPayload`, `decodeInstructionData` and `resolveTransactionAccounts` are looser than this contract. They accept parsed shapes and byte arrays, and do not refuse legacy or v1 loaded addresses. They are not reused, and are not changed.
